preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The list p contains exactly n-1 integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i < i for i, p_i in enumerate(p, start=2))
preconditions.description: Each parent p_i of node i is a valid node number less than i.

postconditions.description: The output is within the range 0 to 998244352 inclusive.
The output is the number of ways to partition the leaves such that for any two different sets x, y of the partition, f(x) and f(y) are disjoint, modulo 998244353.
